profile.description: Purcari Wineries Public Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the production, bottling, and sale of wines in Central and Eastern Europe. The company operates a bar and a restaurant. It is also involved in production, bottling, and sales of divin and brandy; charity, trading and marketing, and IT services; grapes cultivation; and providing finance to other companies, as well as agricultural and hotel services. It offers its products under the Purcari, Crama Ceptura, Bostavan, Domeniile Cuza, Bardar, and Angel's Estate brands. The company exports its products to Romania, the Republic of Moldova, Bulgaria, Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Ukraine, Scandinavian, Poland, Turkey, Baltic countries, the United Kingdom, the Middle East, Nepal, China, Japan, South Korea, Canada, the United States, and internationally. Purcari Wineries Public Company Limited was founded in 1827 and is headquartered in Chisinau, Republic of Moldova.
